integrated.date_range_semantics: Range of actual capture timestamps recorded in source metadata for frozen manifest rows; it does not assert that every current deployed page is from one version or one timestamp.

gaps.sample_semantics: Per-host counts cover only the materialized unresolved_references sample; the manifest total is authoritative for overall unresolved references.

candidate_sources.semantics: Candidate URLs are research leads only. They are not counted as downloaded or integrated material.

limitations: The frozen route/entity inventory is derived from build-manifest files. Supplement records are retained as a separate source-record inventory and are not added to the frozen entity count.
Approved source maps were checked for existing local paths and valid map fields; raw archive trees were not scanned or copied.
Unresolved-reference host counts are limited to the materialized sample in build-manifest.json; the total unresolved count is authoritative.
Candidate URL indexes record possible related-site paths but do not establish capture success or local availability.
No network requests were made while producing this inventory.
